respStmt.resp: Lexical authority compilation and scholarly editing

publicationStmt.p: Working lexical authority for the Digital Corpus of Armenian Colophons. Publication details and licensing will be established for the corpus.

sourceDesc.p: The initial headwords and GREgORI categories are taken from the supplied working editions of col-000001 and col-000002. Supporting dictionaries, definitions, and scholarship will be added when verified.

projectDesc.p: This file identifies lexical entries used in token-level lemmatisation. The aim here will be to develop into a corpus-based lexicon of early Armenian colophons for publication at some point. Individual word forms, case, number, and contextual analysis remain in the editions. Frequencies and attestation lists will be derived from reviewed token references rather than maintained here as duplicate counts.

editorialDecl.p: Lexical-entry identifiers follow the pattern lem-000001. Allocate each ID once and retain it when headword spelling or identification is corrected. Do not reuse retired identifiers. Homonyms, variant headwords, and entries spanning more than one lexical category require assessment using GREgORI's conventions; do not automatically merge entries on identical spelling or split them merely because tokens have different inflections.

Use entry with form/@type lemma and orth for the adopted headword. Record Classical Armenian forms with xml:lang xcl. Optional transliterations and supported lexical spelling variants can be recorded in additional forms. Preserve the exact attested spelling and editorial interventions in the edition's word token; do not turn every inflected occurrence into a new lemma.
Use gramGrp/pos for the lexical GREgORI category and corresp for its definition in pos.xml.

The added morphology layer classifies contextual forms. Case, number, verbal form, tense or stem, mood, voice, and person are recorded at token level, not imposed as fixed properties of the lemma entry. Dictionary-style grammatical information can be added later when its distinction from token morphology is clear and useful.

GREgORI LF denotes an unanalysable form used as its own lemma. If it needs an authority entry, use entry/@type lemmaForm to distinguish it from a lexical entry of type lexical. Use the exact form as orth and the LF definition from pos.xml. Do not attach a guessed dictionary sense. Record the unresolved analysis and review history; explicit assessment is required if it is later identified, merged, or reclassified.
Optional sense elements support reviewed meanings and usage notes for a future lexicon. Assign stable local sense IDs only when senses are added. Multiple senses need not be separate lemmas.

Use bibl references to bibliography.xml for supporting dictionary entries and scholarship. citedRange can identify pages or dictionary headwords. External lexical identifiers can use idno inside a note of type externalIdentifier. Only add verified matches and clarify the dictionary edition used.

Word tokens reference lemmata.xml#lem-000001 through w/@lemmaRef with the correct relative path. A plain w/@lemma string can be supplied for export if useful, but must agree with the referenced entry.

revisionDesc.change: Populated 182 lexical entries using the IDs, headwords, and POS values in col-000001 and col-000002. IDs lem-000168, lem-000169, and lem-000170 were previously allocated to verb lemmas but are not used in this latest edition. No dictionary senses or external lexical identifiers have been inferred.
